# Firstmate attribution

The adapted skills and pinned surface manifest in this plugin derive from
[kunchenguid/firstmate](https://github.com/kunchenguid/firstmate) at commit
`1f3e769616fdf9f31f85f4c3e6a9f71606634238`, licensed under the MIT License.
The complete live script toolbelt remains the installed upstream clone; the BB
backend adapter changes transport without forking its policy scripts.
